class: Control primitive (discrete screen-bezel push button with integrated status LED and label)
verdict: Sam Marquis: "This is fine for now. Re-canonize."

reference.use: Commissioned layout reference: rectangular black key, end-mounted horizontal LED bar, and a high-contrast label occupying the remaining face. Compact keeps that end strip; wide rearranges the text laterally beside a tall vertical end bar.

renderer: Blender 5.2.0 LTS / Cycles; fully procedural geometry and materials; transparent RGBA; active-state emission-pass-only bloom confined to the opaque key
construction: Bevelled mounting receiver, continuous dark rubber reveal, separately raised matte-black key, recessed dark LED socket, flush tinted polycarbonate lens, and flush bold-monospace screen-printed label. Compact and wide variants share the same physical stack.

parameters.layout: --variant compact|wide; --led-end top|bottom or left|right; compact lens 8.6x3.4 mm; current wide defaults are 2.5x10.4 mm with 2.4 mm label clearance and 1.6 mm opposite-side margin
parameters.dimensions: --width/--height in mm, variant defaults 13x24 and 42x16; --scale is coherent

environment.rig: house rig rigs.knob_studio (studio_kominka_03 HDRI, Poly Haven, CC0 + generated zenith scrim and rake); glossy visibility disabled because the key and lens are flat/near-flat and take authored panel-facing reflections
environment.view: AgX Medium High Contrast; dead-on 85 mm perspective; no ground or cast-shadow layer; active LEDs alone receive a restrained thresholded Bloom pass over the opaque key

materials.shared: ../_studio/matlib.py — shared and live, consumed unchanged here
materials.local: custom-color and matte-black moulded finishes, blackened-metal alternate, rubber reveal, screen-print label paint, and tinted emissive polycarbonate LED lens with saturation-preserving radiance, local colored spill, and LED-only bloom

renders.compact-{1,2,3,4}-{active,inactive}.png: compact 13x24 mm four-number bank, matte-black-plastic, bold monospace painted labels, top LED roster red/green/blue/purple, paired explicit states
renders.wide-bank-{1,2,3,4}-{active,inactive}.pn: wide 42x16 mm four-number bank, matte-black-plastic, bold monospace painted labels, left LED roster red/green/blue/purple, paired explicit states
renders.wide-left-{active,inactive}.png: wide 42x16 mm, text SOURCE, 10.4 mm tall left cyan LED, matte-black-plastic, bold monospace painted label, paired explicit states
renders.wide-right-{active,inactive}.png: wide 42x16 mm, text BYPASS, 10.4 mm tall right red LED, matte-black-plastic, bold monospace painted label, paired explicit states

canon_baseline: p84 r3 is the current consumable canon
author: OpenAI Sol under Sam Marquis's commission
no_ai_generation: No diffusion or generative image model produced geometry, texture, text, or pixels in renders/.
